scholarships.name: Kaplan Early Bird Scholarship
scholarships.description: Early-bird discount applied automatically when you pay the deposit at least 90 days before the start of your Kaplan pathway course (Foundation or Pre-Master's).
scholarships.descriptionRu: Автоматическая скидка при оплате депозита не менее чем за 90 дней до начала программы Kaplan (Foundation или Pre-Master's). Доступна на каждом из партнёрских университетов.

scholarships.name: Kaplan Academic Achievement Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for top-performing applicants on Kaplan pathway programmes. Awarded after academic review of transcripts.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Стипендия за академические заслуги для лучших абитуриентов программ Kaplan. Присуждается после проверки академических документов.

accommodation.name: En-suite комната в студенческом общежитии (SRH International College)
accommodation.text: Одноместная комната с собственной ванной, общая кухня на 4–8 человек. Партнёрское жильё рядом с кампусом SRH International College.

paragraphs: Higher education in Germany is renowned for top-quality teaching and an education style that prioritises practical, work-focused learning experiences. The country is home to a booming job market and is one of the global hubs for the industries of tech, IT, engineering, science, and more. German cities are safe, diverse and welcoming. In Germany, students experience a first-class university education and a contemporary lifestyle, right in the heart of Europe.
Navitas offers two options for students wishing to study in Germany – SRH International College and Lancaster University Leipzig campus.
At SRH International College, students can choose from a university foundation program or a Pre-Master’s program.

Lancaster University Leipzig is a branch campus of Lancaster University, UK. LU Leipzig offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs, with the university committed to providing the same academic quality and fully rounded student experience as in the UK.
